propositions: 344 closed bugs lack aggregated metrics lens to answer trend questions on close_class distribution, detection channel, age, caused_by fan-in, and time-to-close without ad-hoc scripts
Pre-convention bugs (~214) lack close_class annotation; the lens must surface them as an explicit labeled MISSING cohort to prevent silent era mixing
Detected_by field is sparse and will be absent initially; the lens dimension must degrade gracefully to unavailable state without breaking other dimensions

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures ignoring range semantics
The lens must register via the standard registry _spec() pattern and integrate into the metrics/__init__.py side-effect import chain alongside event_metrics, git_metrics, sidecar_metrics
